name: Trustworthiness
overview: Scripture highlights the importance of trustworthiness as a reflection of a faithful spirit, contrasting it with the folly of relying on one's own heart and the sin of revealing secrets. Proverbs condemns those who betray confidence and praises those who conceal matters faithfully, while Luke encourages wise stewardship of earthly resources to secure eternal fellowship. The call to honesty is further underscored in Colossians, which exhorts believers to put away deceit as part of their new life in Christ.
